title: Smallest Index With Equal Value
summary: Find the smallest index in an array where the index modulo 10 equals the value at that index, or return -1 if no such index exists.
statement: Find the smallest index in an array where the index modulo 10 equals the value at that index, or return -1 if no such index exists.
constraints: nums has 1 through 100 integers from 0 through 9.
Find an index i satisfying i modulo 10 equals nums[i].
Return the smallest such index, or -1 if none exists.
hints: The condition can be tested independently at each position.
Scan from left to right and return immediately on index modulo ten equality.
for i,x: if i%10==x return i; return -1.
Left-to-right order makes the first match the smallest, and exhausting the list proves no match exists.
editorial: Left-to-right order makes the first match the smallest, and exhausting the list proves no match exists.

tests.explanation: Index zero satisfies zero modulo ten equals zero, so it is the smallest.
Index two satisfies two modulo ten equals two.
